title: MiMo-VL Technical Report
paper_type_zh: 前沿多模态模型技术报告与数据披露台账
best_for_zh: 审计长 CoT 预训练与混合在线 RL 披露边界的读者。
one_line: MiMo-VL reports synthetic long-CoT regeneration with rejection sampling in later pre-training and mixed on-policy RL, but does not release the underlying traces, reward contract, or corpus audit.
MiMo-VL 报告 2.4T token 四阶段预训练、长 CoT 推理数据与 MORL，但未披露数据来源、奖励契约、rollout 或审计细节。
why: It provides a useful disclosure ledger for a frontier multimodal reasoner because it separates released checkpoints and evaluation prompts from undisclosed data provenance, acceptance decisions, and mixed-RL feedback details.
inclusion_reason: Official frontier report with unusually concrete high-level disclosure of long-CoT synthesis, rejection sampling, MORL, checkpoints, and evaluation, while the evidence ledger keeps the missing item-level data and reward contract visible.

title: Problem
问题
html:
MiMo-VL addresses a coupled data problem in compact vision-language modeling: preserving broad visual perception while transferring the language backbone’s reasoning ability into image, video, document, GUI, and text settings. The report argues that short-answer multimodal QA is insufficient supervision for this goal. Its alternative is a staged mixture of large-scale multimodal pre-training, synthetic long-chain-of-thought reasoning data, long-context SFT, and mixed on-policy reinforcement learning.

For a data atlas, the important object is not the 7B model alone. It is the stack of caption, interleaved, OCR, grounding, video, GUI, reasoning, preference, and RL query collections, together with modality-specific filters and reward routes. The report gives useful pipeline-level disclosure, but does not publish the training corpus, item manifests, mixture proportions, teacher identities, preference pairs, or reward logs.

MiMo-VL 处理的是紧凑型视觉语言模型中的耦合数据问题：既要保持广泛的视觉感知能力，又要把语言骨干的推理能力迁移到图像、视频、文档、GUI 与纯文本任务。报告认为，只有短答案的多模态问答不足以提供这种监督，因此采用大规模分阶段多模态预训练、合成长思维链推理数据、长上下文 SFT，以及混合在线策略强化学习。

对数据图谱而言，核心对象不只是 7B 模型，而是由图文描述、交错图文、OCR、定位、视频、GUI、推理、偏好和 RL 查询构成的数据栈，以及对应的模态专用过滤器与奖励路由。报告披露了有价值的流程级信息，但没有发布训练语料、样本清单、混合比例、教师模型身份、偏好对或奖励日志。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
The central idea is to make reasoning supervision part of the later pre-training distribution rather than a small post-hoc instruction-tuning add-on. Open-source questions spanning perceptual QA, document QA, video QA, visual reasoning, web content, and literary works are filtered; a large reasoning model regenerates explicit long-CoT answers; and multi-stage checks retain answers and reasoning processes judged correct, clear, non-redundant, and consistently formatted. Stage 4 then increases the reasoning share and introduces long-form reasoning under a 32K sequence length.

Post-training uses Mixed On-policy Reinforcement Learning (MORL), which jointly serves rule-verifiable tasks and preference alignment. A task-aware router selects Math-Verify, spatial/temporal overlap, exact counting, or one of two learned reward models, allowing text, image, and video tasks to share a fully on-policy GRPO training loop.

核心思路是把推理监督纳入后期预训练分布，而不是仅作为少量、事后的指令微调补充。团队先收集并过滤涵盖感知问答、文档问答、视频问答、视觉推理、网页内容和文学作品的开源问题，再用大型推理模型生成显式长思维链答案，并通过多阶段检查保留答案正确、推理清晰、无冗余且格式一致的样本。第 4 阶段进一步提高推理数据占比，并在 32K 序列长度下加入长程推理模式。

后训练采用混合在线策略强化学习（MORL），把规则可验证任务与偏好对齐放入同一框架。任务感知路由器按任务选择 Math-Verify、空间或时间重叠、计数准确率，或两个学习型奖励模型之一，使文本、图像和视频任务能够共享完全在线策略的 GRPO 训练循环。

title: Method
方法
html:
Pre-training consumes 2.4T tokens in four stages: 300B for projector warm-up on image-caption pairs; 167B for vision-language alignment with interleaved data; 1.4T for all-parameter multimodal pre-training; and 550B for 32K long-context SFT. The third stage mixes OCR, grounding, video, GUI, limited QA/instruction/reasoning data, and some text-only data. The fourth adds long text, documents, high-resolution images, extended videos, and a much larger share of long reasoning data.

Curation is modality-specific. Captions are deduplicated with perceptual hashes and text filters, re-captioned, checked for linguistic consistency and repetition, and distribution-balanced with bilingual metadata. Interleaved pages, books, and papers are filtered for readable, knowledge-dense text and informative, safe, relevant images. Video data receives event-level captions with timestamps; GUI data includes grounding, standardized cross-platform action trajectories, and synthetic Chinese examples. Benchmark images are separately checked with phash-based deduplication.

For RLVR, the report gives a concrete 80K visual-reasoning set: open and proprietary K–12 questions are converted toward free-answer forms, filtered by model-estimated difficulty, stripped of image-irrelevant items, cleaned, and category-balanced. Rewards use Math-Verify for text/visual reasoning, GIoU or point-in-box for grounding, exact count accuracy, and temporal IoU for video localization. RLHF queries come from open instruction sets and in-house writing, are screened and clustered, balanced across Chinese/English and helpfulness/harmlessness, answered by several models, and pairwise ranked by an advanced VLM. Text and multimodal reward models use a Bradley–Terry objective. MORL runs a fully on-policy GRPO variant with one update per rollout, no KL loss, dynamic sampling, easy-data filtering, and resampling; rewards are routed as services and no separate format reward is used.

预训练共消耗 2.4T token，分为四个阶段：300B token 的图文对投影器预热；167B token 的交错图文视觉—语言对齐；1.4T token 的全参数通用多模态预训练；以及 550B token、32K 序列长度的长上下文 SFT。第 3 阶段混合 OCR、定位、视频、GUI、少量问答/指令/推理数据和部分纯文本；第 4 阶段加入长文本、长文档、高分辨率图像、长视频，并显著提高长推理数据占比。

数据治理按模态分别设计。图文描述先用感知哈希和文本规则去重，再统一重描述，并检查语言一致性与重复模式，最后借助中英双语元数据平衡分布。网页、书籍和论文的交错图文按文本可读性、知识密度，以及图像安全性、信息量和图文相关性过滤。视频数据生成带起止时间的事件级描述；GUI 数据覆盖定位、统一跨平台动作空间的长轨迹，并补充合成中文界面样本。团队还单独使用 phash 检查训练图像与评测基准的潜在重叠。

RLVR 部分披露了较具体的 80K 视觉推理集：来自开放社区和自有 K–12 集合的问题被改写为更适合自由作答的形式，经模型难度评估过滤，移除无需图像即可求解的样本，再清洗并做类别平衡。文本与视觉推理使用 Math-Verify，定位使用 GIoU 或点落框内判定，计数使用答案准确率，视频时间定位使用时间段 IoU。RLHF 查询来自开放指令集和内部人工撰写，经过筛选、聚类，并在中英文及有用性/无害性间平衡；多个模型生成候选答案后，由高级 VLM 两两排序。文本与多模态奖励模型均采用 Bradley–Terry 目标。MORL 使用每次 rollout 后仅更新一步的完全在线策略 GRPO，移除 KL 损失，并加入动态采样、简单样本过滤与重采样；奖励以服务形式路由，且不额外加入格式奖励。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The report supports the recipe with ablations and a broad evaluation suite, but these results should be read as model evidence, not direct proof that every retained training item is high quality. The clearest data-linked result is the Stage-4 comparison: the checkpoint trained with a larger reasoning share and long-form reasoning performs better on difficult multimodal and text reasoning than the earlier checkpoint. The discussion reports gains across the tested synthetic-reasoning scaling comparisons without observed saturation, but does not establish a fully controlled single-variable causal estimate.

For post-training, MORL improves many reasoning, perception, and grounding evaluations over the SFT checkpoint, while the authors explicitly document interference among task families. Their comparison of fully on-policy training with vanilla GRPO reports better stability and exploration for the chosen setup. The repository releases SFT and RL checkpoints plus an evaluation framework with prompts and protocols, enabling capability checks. It does not release the training examples, reward models, verifier service, sampling manifests, or per-example acceptance records, so independent reconstruction of the data pipeline remains unavailable.

报告通过消融实验和广泛评测支撑训练方案，但这些结果只能视为模型层面的证据，不能直接证明每个保留训练样本都具有高质量。与数据最直接相关的证据是第 4 阶段对比：采用更高推理数据占比和长程推理训练的检查点，在困难多模态推理与文本推理上优于更早检查点。讨论部分报告，在所测试的合成推理数据规模比较中仍有收益且尚未观察到饱和，但这并不构成严格的单变量因果估计。

后训练方面，MORL 相对 SFT 检查点改善了多项推理、感知和定位评测，同时作者明确记录了任务族之间的干扰。报告将完全在线策略训练与普通 GRPO 比较，认为前者在该设置下具有更好的稳定性与探索性。官方仓库发布了 SFT、RL 检查点以及包含提示和协议的评测框架，可用于能力复核；但训练样本、奖励模型、验证服务、采样清单和逐样本验收记录均未发布，因此无法独立重建数据流水线。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
MiMo-VL’s contribution is primarily a disclosed training-data composition and reward integration recipe rather than a new public dataset. Two choices are especially relevant: placing substantial synthetic long-CoT multimodal reasoning data inside later pre-training, and routing heterogeneous rule-based and learned rewards through one mixed, fully on-policy RL run. The report also specifies different verification contracts for symbolic answers, boxes, points, counts, temporal segments, and human-preference proxies.

This is distinct from treating all multimodal examples as generic QA or scoring every domain with one judge model. However, the novelty claim should remain bounded: many component techniques—re-captioning, rejection sampling, GRPO, Bradley–Terry reward modeling, and task-specific verifiers—are established. The report’s value lies in how these components are combined and scaled for a compact VLM.

MiMo-VL 的主要贡献是披露一套训练数据组合与奖励整合方案，而不是发布新的公共数据集。最值得关注的两个选择是：把大量合成长思维链多模态推理数据直接放入后期预训练，以及在一次混合、完全在线策略的 RL 过程中，通过路由统一使用异构的规则奖励和学习型奖励。报告还分别明确了符号答案、框、点、计数、时间片段和人类偏好代理的验证契约。

这不同于把所有多模态样本都当作通用问答，或让单一评审模型为所有领域打分。不过，新颖性应保持边界：重描述、拒绝采样、GRPO、Bradley–Terry 奖励建模和任务专用验证器本身都不是新技术。报告的价值主要在于这些组件如何被组合并扩展到紧凑型 VLM。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
The largest limitation is disclosure. Corpus source inventories, URLs, licenses, language/domain counts, exact mixture weights, teacher model identities, generation prompts, rejection thresholds, stage-wise yields, and rejected records are unknown. The 80K visual-reasoning set is described but not released, and its proprietary K–12 component cannot be independently audited. Preference data sizes, annotator involvement, judge calibration, reward-model accuracy, and disagreement handling are also not reported.

Verifier coverage is heterogeneous: symbolic tasks have executable checks, but learned reward models stand in for human preference, and the report gives no false-positive/false-negative analysis for any reward route. phash image deduplication reduces exact or near-exact visual overlap but does not establish semantic decontamination across text, questions, videos, or transformed samples. The authors further observe cross-domain RL interference and unequal response-length and difficulty dynamics, so simultaneous gains are not guaranteed. Released code and model licenses do not establish rights to reproduce or redistribute the underlying corpus or trajectories.

最大局限是披露不足。语料来源清单、URL、许可证、语言与领域计数、精确混合权重、教师模型身份、生成提示、拒绝阈值、各阶段保留率和被拒样本均未知。80K 视觉推理集虽有描述但未发布，其中自有 K–12 部分无法独立审计。偏好数据规模、人工标注参与方式、评审模型校准、奖励模型准确率以及分歧处理也没有报告。

验证覆盖并不均一：符号任务具备可执行检查，但人类偏好由学习型奖励模型代理，报告没有给出任何奖励路由的假阳性或假阴性分析。phash 图像去重只能降低完全相同或近似视觉重叠，不能证明文本、问题、视频或变换样本实现了语义级去污染。作者还观察到跨领域 RL 干扰，以及回答长度和难度演化不一致，因此并不能保证所有能力同步提升。代码与模型许可证也不等于底层语料和轨迹具备可复现或可再分发权利。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
This report is useful as a design reference for multimodal reasoning-data programs that must combine perception, reasoning, localization, video, GUI interaction, and preference alignment. It provides a practical map from task object to verifier: symbolic equivalence, spatial overlap, containment, exact counting, temporal overlap, or a modality-specific learned reward. Its staged token budgets and separation of alignment, general multimodal learning, long-context reasoning, and RL also support recipe planning.

It is less useful as a source of reusable data. No training corpus, manifest, preference set, synthetic trace collection, or reward implementation is available. The Card should therefore be used to compare construction patterns and audit questions—not to claim a reproducible dataset or to infer that benchmark gains alone validate data quality.

这份报告适合作为多模态推理数据工程的设计参考，尤其适用于需要同时覆盖感知、推理、定位、视频、GUI 交互与偏好对齐的项目。它给出了清晰的“任务对象—验证器”映射：符号等价、空间重叠、点包含、精确计数、时间重叠，或模态专用学习型奖励。分阶段 token 预算，以及视觉—语言对齐、通用多模态学习、长上下文推理和 RL 的区分，也有助于训练配方规划。

但它不适合作为可复用数据源：训练语料、样本清单、偏好集、合成轨迹集合和奖励实现均未开放。因此，本卡更适合用于比较构建模式和提出审计问题，而不能据此宣称数据集可复现，也不能把基准提升直接等同于数据质量得到验证。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Read Sections 2.2–2.3 first for the actual data objects, modality-specific filtering, four-stage token budgets, and the special role of long reasoning data in Stage 4.
  • In Section 3, separate RLVR’s rule-verifiable tasks from RLHF’s model-ranked preference pairs; they have different evidence strength and failure modes.
  • Treat the 80K figure as applying only to the disclosed visual-reasoning RLVR set, not to the full synthetic reasoning corpus or all MORL data.
  • Use Section 5’s interference discussion as a first-class limitation: a mixed reward service does not eliminate cross-domain optimization conflicts.
  • Check the repository and model pages for released checkpoints and evaluation code, but do not infer that their licenses cover undisclosed training data.

• 先读第 2.2–2.3 节，确认实际数据对象、各模态过滤流程、四阶段 token 预算，以及长推理数据在第 4 阶段的特殊作用。
  • 阅读第 3 节时，应把 RLVR 的规则可验证任务与 RLHF 的模型排序偏好对分开；两者的证据强度和失效模式不同。
  • 80K 仅指披露的视觉推理 RLVR 集，不能外推到完整合成推理语料或全部 MORL 数据。
  • 把第 5 节的任务干扰讨论视为主要局限：统一奖励服务并不会消除跨领域优化冲突。
  • 官方仓库与模型页可确认已发布的检查点和评测代码，但其许可证不能被推断为覆盖未披露的训练数据。
